title: cancelling a running query races connection close without touching a closed connection
purpose: Audit S04 (#18): sqlite3_interrupt from a cancellation must reach an open connection or nothing while the worker closes it.

provenance.origin: authored for #18 from the audit 2026-11-01 S04 finding
provenance.expected_basis: Cancelling the future of a running statement interrupts it (the recursive query would otherwise run for minutes) and the await observes Cancelled, whether the close is queued before or after the cancel; the closed connection is never interrupted and later connections work.
